$schema_comment: docs/execution/automation/MODEL_POLICY.json — role-based model selection. Candidates use model IDs actually discovered via `opencode models`. Availability is determined at runtime by discovery; this file only orders candidates per role. Families enforce reviewer independence.

router.purpose: Typed classification and routing among fixed labels. Advisory only; never writes code or declares PASS/DONE.

preferred.note: absent from installed environment; expect UNAVAILABLE

implementation.purpose: Bounded checkpoint implementation: repository edits plus focused local tests.

mechanical.purpose: Mechanical test additions, doc consistency, narrow repetitive refactors, low-risk fixes.

review.purpose: Adversarial candidate review, failure triage, bounded root-cause investigation. Must differ in family from the implementation worker.

experimental_advisory.purpose: Read-only review, alternative diagnosis, test ideas. Never authoritative; recorded as advisory telemetry only.

architecture.purpose: Architecture contradiction, platform design conflict, causal-repair failure, licensing, schema, security, or evidence-contract decisions. Expensive and exceptional.

preferred.note: Sol-class reasoning via locally installed Codex CLI; invocation is configurable, quota-aware, and optional
